resource.name: AlderwoodDemoBenefitCategory
resource.title: Alderwood Demo Benefit Category Codes (fictive)
resource.publisher: Fictive — enrollment/Certificate of Coverage demo project
resource.description: Local, fictive code system for per-service-category cost-sharing rows (the 'Common Medical Events' grid of a Summary of Benefits and Coverage). Invented because base FHIR R4 and HL7's coverage-copay-type CodeSystem only cover a handful of these concepts (gpvisit, spvisit, emergency, inpthosp, televisit, urgentcare) — not the full SBC grid (imaging, Rx tiers, DME, hospice, pediatric vision/dental, etc). Used as InsurancePlan.plan.specificCost.category and .benefit.type, and as InsurancePlan.coverage.benefit.type.
